fieldValues.title: A choice follows the group lean, or it is asked
fieldValues.decision_question: When may an agent take a choice that sits on one of the group tension axes without asking?
fieldValues.context: Proposed by agent:claude-code from the srs-lab control room (clerk#77). Prototyped against the live PRs on 2026-10-17: clerk#57 asked for thirteen decisions already ratified; srs-programme#154 and #155 proposed decisions only inside their diffs, in state draft; clerk#75 stated a constraining design principle in prose.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A choice that follows the group lean on one of its axes is taken and cites the lean or principle; a choice against the lean is asked of the group or its parent; on an axis with no lean it is a ruling.
fieldValues.rationale: Principles and the group trigram make most choices automatic; asking only where the compass is silent or crossed keeps human attention for real tradeoffs.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When groups have affirmed trigrams and asks against the lean are still frequent, or never happen.
